shortDescription: Allows operations with IONOS CLOUD Postgres Clusters.

options.name: allow_replace
options.description: Boolean indicating if the resource should be recreated when the state cannot be reached in another way. This may be used to prevent resources from being deleted from specifying a different value to an immutable property. An error will be thrown instead

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: backup_id
options.description: The ID of the backup to be used.

options.name: backup_location
options.description: The S3 location where the backups will be stored.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: connections
options.description: Array of datacenters to connect to your cluster.

options.name: cores
options.description: The number of CPU cores per instance.

options.name: db_password
options.description: The password for the initial postgres user.

options.name: db_username
options.description: The username for the initial PostgreSQL user. Some system usernames are restricted (e.g. "postgres", "admin", "standby").

options.name: display_name
options.description: The friendly name of your cluster.

options.name: instances
options.description: The total number of instances in the cluster (one master and n-1 standbys).

options.name: location
options.description: The physical location where the cluster will be created. This will be where all of your instances live. Property cannot be modified after datacenter creation.

options.name: maintenance_window
options.description: A weekly 4 hour-long window, during which maintenance might occur.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: postgres_cluster
options.description: The ID or name of an existing Postgres Cluster.

options.name: postgres_version
options.description: The PostgreSQL version of your cluster.

options.name: ram
options.description: The amount of memory per instance in megabytes. Has to be a multiple of 1024.

options.name: recovery_target_time
options.description: Recovery target time.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: storage_size
options.description: The amount of storage per instance in megabytes.

options.name: storage_type
options.description: The storage type used in your cluster. (Value "SSD" is deprecated. Use the equivalent "SSD Premium" instead)

options.name: synchronization_mode
options.description: Represents the supported replication modes when creating a cluster. The SYNCHRONOUS mode is deprecated and cannot be used in create requests. It may still appear on existing clusters via the SynchronizationMode response schema. You may update your cluster to one of the supported modes yourself. Else, it will eventually be migrated to one of the supported modes.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
